topics.label: Passive voice
topics.focus: The passive: what happens to something, not who does it — ‘Our kitchen was painted last spring.’

topics.label: Tenses
topics.focus: Tenses: the form that fits the time — ‘I’ve known her since we were six.’

topics.label: Conditionals
topics.focus: Conditionals: an ‘if’ part and its result — ‘If it snows, we’ll build a snowman.’

topics.label: Past modals
topics.focus: Past modals: guessing, judging or regretting the past — ‘She must have missed the bus.’

topics.label: Comparatives
topics.focus: Comparatives: two or more things compared — ‘This one is far lighter than mine.’

topics.label: Reported speech
topics.focus: Reported speech: what another person said — ‘He said he was hungry.’

topics.label: Linking words
topics.focus: Linking words: two ideas joined by the right link — ‘Although it was late, we kept walking.’

topics.label: Inversion
topics.focus: Inversion: the verb before the subject, for emphasis — ‘Not once did she complain.’

topics.label: Gerunds & infinitives
topics.focus: Gerunds and infinitives: the -ing form, to, or the plain verb — ‘I miss living by the sea.’

topics.label: Miscellaneous
topics.focus: A mix of B2 grammar, one point in each sentence.

topics.label: Similar words
topics.focus: Words close in meaning, where the sentence decides — ‘a march’, not ‘an outing’, through London.

topics.label: Topic vocabulary
topics.focus: Words for the topics B2 First writes about.

topics.label: Descriptive words
topics.focus: Adjectives, adverbs, verbs and collective nouns that describe precisely.

topics.label: Phrasal verbs
topics.focus: Phrasal verbs: the particle that completes the meaning.

topics.label: Academic vocabulary
topics.focus: Academic words for reading and writing.

topics.label: Word formation
topics.focus: Word formation, Part 3: decide what the gap needs — a noun, an adjective, a verb or an adverb — then build it.
